title: Pullback preserves finite constant local models
statement: For a commutative condensed ring Λ, any scheme morphism g:X→Y and internal module M over Λ_Y, HasFiniteConstantLocalModel Λ Y M implies HasFiniteConstantLocalModel Λ X (g* M), with the convention of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. The proof retains each finitely presented condensed model on the base change of its witnessing cover.

proof.text: Base change the witnessing cover, spelling out its domains and projections so their module-category instances share the same domain expression. For each member let q be the first projection typed from that cover member. Compare the two composite inverse images by upperStarComp and pullback.condition. Pull back the original model along q. The mapModCompIso comparison for upperStarFromPointComp, followed by extension/comap cancellation along the invertible condensedPullbackHom, identifies it with the same finite condensed model on the new member. The original finite-presentation witness is retained. The proof applies unchanged to empty schemes, empty covering families, and the zero ring.
